_comment: Card tiers (spec §5.6). tierScore = best of the batting and bowling percentiles (each among rated player-editions of that skill) + allRoundBonus × max(0, second − 0.5). `thresholds` are percentile cut-offs on that score (Elite = top 8% of a skill) and are the rarity dial: tune with unbeaten-run rarity once the engine exists. Caps: a best skill on a thin form sample cannot exceed `thin.tier`; a low-sample best skill cannot exceed `lowSample`. phaseBadge marks a per-phase number as thin below these form+career balls.
